verdict.rationale: PayPal offers official REST API SDKs, code generation tooling (paypal-rest-api-specifications), sandbox testing environment, webhooks, and an official Agent Toolkit enabling integration with LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and MCP for AI-native/agentic development. This combination directly supports AI-native developers building against official, well-documented SDKs and agent-facing tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality or Agent Toolkit reliability beyond vendor docs.
